messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: sales-ops@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Orphaned opportunities cleanup + final commit window

Team —

Quick note ahead of week close: Sales Ops pulled a batch of ~48 opportunities that are currently "Negotiation/Review" but show no owner activity in the last 60 days and have missing/placeholder close dates. These are high noise for Finance forecast; we need to triage before the Friday commit window.

Ask: please review the attached CSV and do one of the following by 11:00 PT on Thursday (2027-06-30):
- Confirm commit: update SFDC stage to the correct stage and set a realistic close date
- No-Go / Archive: update stage to "Not Pursuing" and add reason (no budget / no timeline)
- Reassign: if you are not the right owner, reassign and add a one-line note in the Opportunity comments field

How I prioritized: batch contains deals > $25k ARR where Opportunity Age > 120 days and contact activity < 2 touches in 60 days. This is a lightweight hygiene pass — the goal is to remove noisy records from the forecast not to reopen cold pursuits.

If you need the list split or want a short triage slot, I have 15 minute blocks tomorrow (Wed) 10:15–11:00 and 14:00–15:00 PT. Reply with a slot and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachment: 20270630-orphaned-opps-batch-1.csv (columns: OppId, Account, Owner, Stage, Amount, CloseDate, LastActivityDate, Notes)

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Ava — thanks for the heads up. A couple of clarifying Qs before I dig in: 
1) For records with "No Recent Contact" but an inline note referencing a partner intro, should we prioritize those for reassignment instead of archive?
2) Will Sales Ops update the "Forecast Category" field when you mark No-Go? Finance wants a deterministic reason so forecasting rollups are clean.

If Sales Ops can append a single column in the CSV with one of these tags: REASSIGN / NOGO / NEEDS_CONTRACT, that will make triage faster. I can take the west-coast cluster and push updates this morning.

-Marcus
Account Exec, West
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 08:41 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ava — thanks for the heads up. A couple of clarifying Qs before I dig in:
> 1) For records with "No Recent Contact" but an inline note referencing a partner intro, should we prioritize those for reassignment instead of archive?
> 2) Will Sales Ops update the "Forecast Category" field when you mark No-Go? Finance wants a deterministic reason so forecasting rollups are clean.

Good questions — answers below and next steps: 
- Reassign in the base case if there is an active partner intro within last 120 days. We want the owning AE or partner lead to make the call.
- Sales Ops will set Forecast Category to one of: Commit / Best Case / Pipeline / No-Go when you update the stage. Please add a single-line comment explaining the decision.

I've updated the CSV (new column: triage_tag) and re-attached it to Sales Ops Workbench for immediate edits: https://drive.redwood.com/ops/forecast-cleanup/2027-06-orphans

Please action your assigned subset by 11:00 PT today. I'll run a final filter and remove archived deals from Friday's commit view.

If anyone hits a stuck item (legal, procurement timeline, SOW), loop in the external contact and cc me — example: Orbit Analytics (sara@orbitanalytics.com) has a pending procurement timeline question.

Thanks all — appreciate quick turn on this.

Ava
Senior Sales Operations Manager
